The award winning Horse Talk TV is Australia’s most popular lifestyle TV show on horses. Winner of the prestigious 2010 Antenna Award for Outstanding Lifestyle TV show, Horse Talk TV has been entertain audiences since 2009 with stories about horses and the people who love them
With 4 seasons broadcast across Australia and Internationally in New Zealand, the USA and Europe, Horse Talk TV is a ‘must watch’ for the horse enthusiast. 
Horse Talk TV is the best place to see great horse stories, meet top horse trainers and learn tips & techniques on horse care and riding.   

Subscribe to our You Tube channel https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwAIU3jgj-uMGGypGCuiS4g , visit our website http://horsetalktv.com.au/ or join our FB Page https://www.facebook.com/pages/Horse-Talk-TV/166407466414 for more great horse stories
